svg.title: SLU-PP-332's key studies: mice, cells and test tubes
svg.desc: SLU-PP-332's key studies: mice, cells and test tubes. ACS Chem Biol 2023: Male mice, injected, 7 days; 6 per group. Result: Ran ~70% longer. Model: Mice. J Pharmacol Exp Ther 2024: Obese male mice, 28 days; 8 to 10 per group. Result: ~12% lower weight. Model: Mice. Circulation 2024: Mice with pressure-overload heart failure. Result: Better pumping, survival. Model: Mice. Am J Pathol 2023: 21-month-old mice, 8 weeks. Result: Kidney aging markers fell. Model: Mice. Front Physiol 2025: Muscle cells from 10 inactive women, in a dish. Result: Healthier cell markers. Model: Cells. Doping labs 2026 (two): Human liver fractions in a test tube. Result: 9 and 22 breakdown products. Model: Lab test. Human trials: ClinicalTrials.gov and PubMed, Oct 25, 2026. Result: None found. Model: None.
